subject: Re: Great meeting at FinTech Summit — follow up on inference needs
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechx.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Great to meet you at FinTech Summit — quick follow up

Alex — great meeting you at the FinTech Summit booth this morning. Thanks for the quick chat about how FinTechX is looking to reduce latency and cost on real-time fraud scoring.

As promised, I wanted to share a short recap and next steps so we can keep momentum:
- Recap: you mentioned ~50 qps peak, strict p99 latency target of <100ms for critical scoring, and a desire to try a hybrid approach (hosted for dev/prod testing, potential dedicated capacity for peak hours).
- Next step: 30–45m discovery call to review sample traffic, SLOs, and a mutual action plan (I recommend including a quick trace of your current scoring latency).

I've attached a 2-page quickdeck that shows predictable latency profiles for a few RIs (Redwood) deployment patterns and a SOC2 extract you asked about. Camila from our infra team is cc'd and can join the discovery for an architecture deep-dive.

Would you be available for a quick call this week or early next? Times I have free: Tue 3/2 10–12 PST, Wed 3/3 14–16 PST.

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-inference-quickdeck.pdf (pdf, 2 pages), soc2-extract-2026.xlsx (xlsx, redacted)
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechx.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Great to meet you at FinTech Summit — quick follow up

Marissa — thanks for following up and for the materials. The deck looks useful. I should be able to carve out time for a discovery call; Wed 3/3 15:00 PST (3:00pm your time) works for me.

A couple quick notes to prep Camila:
- Our scoring service is a microservice written in Go, runs in k8s, and calls an LLM for risk signals.
- Typical requests: 35–55 qps, spikes to ~120 qps during settlement windows.
- Data sensitivity: tokenized PII; we'd need to confirm KMS and retention controls.

If you can send a calendar invite, I'll add our infra lead (infra@fintechx.com). Looking forward to the call.

— Alex
Head of Fraud Detection
FinTechX

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Checking in — next steps after our discovery (bump)

Hey Alex — wanted to bump this thread since I haven't seen a follow-up from your infra team after our call. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Action items we took: Camila to draft an initial mutual action plan with target p99 and batching recommendations; Marissa to propose a pilot footprint and cost estimate.
- Deliverables: draft MAP + pilot estimate + SOC2 extracts (attached previously).

Are you still the right person to move this forward? If priorities have shifted, totally understand — can we check timing? Options:
- Move forward this quarter: we can fast-track a 2-week pilot on hosted capacity + a performance review.
- Prefer Q3: we can schedule a planning checkpoint and provide a scoped architecture doc for internal review.

If neither, would you point me to the right contact? Happy to be flexible.

Thanks,
Marissa

P.S. attaching the quickdeck again for easy reference.

Attachments: redwood-inference-quickdeck.pdf
